body.objective: An optional, version-pinned FLINT 3.x / Arb / Acb / Calcium bridge that acts as an independent exact-or-rigorous oracle for Forge polynomial, spectral and validated-matrix kernels. Use a narrow C shim and canonical serialized values rather than exposing FLINT object layouts. First consumers are the repeated-root Schwarzschild asymptotic matrices behind Paper 14 and the Paper-13 resultant/minimal-polynomial fixtures. Ubuntu 26.04 supplies libflint-dev 3.4.0 but no flint.pc, so discovery must not require pkg-config.
body.stop_condition: a Forge gate records the FLINT build/version and independently cross-checks one committed Paper-14 repeated-root matrix characteristic/minimal polynomial plus rigorous Acb eigenvalue clusters, and one committed Paper-13 polynomial resultant; outputs are converted into canonical Forge exact values or explicitly tagged rigorous enclosures, and mutations of a matrix entry and enclosure bound are rejected
body.forbid: using FLINT as both producer and verifier; treating an Arb/Acb enclosure as an exact symbolic value; allowing raw FLINT pointers or ownership to escape the adapter; depending only on pkg-config; replacing Forge canonical types with opaque external objects; omitting precision, version, build options, licence or dependency provenance; promoting a numerical enclosure to asymptotic admissibility, stability or a particle claim
notes: 2026-07-19 forge-coordinator: ACCEPTED — mirrored as sf:program/work/M15-flint-oracle. libflint-dev 3.4.0 confirmed installed with headers (Arb/Acb/Calcium merged into FLINT 3.x); discovery will not use pkg-config per your note. Narrow C shim + canonical serialized values; producer/verifier separation honored (FLINT is the INDEPENDENT rail, never both sides).
